title: Stale-index rebuild triggers differ by resource kind
answers: Why does a Bleve file index keep returning stale/zero values after a deploy?
Does Grafana automatically rebuild search indexes when the mapping changes?
body: A Bleve file index keeps the schema/mapping it was built with, so a mapping change (e.g. a new stored field) has no effect on existing indexes until they're rebuilt. Dashboards recover via IndexRebuildInterval; all other resource kinds rely on MaxFileIndexAge, which defaults to no age-based rebuild at all — so a mapping change for non-dashboard kinds can persist indefinitely without an explicit forced rebuild (e.g. via RequiredIndexFeatures).
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource search indexing (Bleve file indexes), any new field/mapping added to stored documents
says: Search index stays stale and returns empty results after updating fields
Where to configure automatic search index rebuilding when the schema changes
Should the system automatically rebuild search indexes after a field mapping update
Why dashboards rebuild their search index but other resources do not
Setting up automatic index refresh when resource schema definitions change
search: Bleve file index mapping changes require resource-kind-specific rebuild triggers in pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go via RequiredIndexFeatures. Dashboards recover via IndexRebuildInterval, but all other resource kinds rely solely on MaxFileIndexAge which defaults to no age-based rebuild—meaning non-dashboard mapping changes persist indefinitely without explicit forced rebuild. Applies when adding new fields or mappings to stored documents in unified storage search indexes and needing to invalidate existing index state. The divergent recovery mechanism is a pitfall when extending resource kinds beyond dashboards.
